mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS boardId, p.title AS title, p.description AS content, p.price AS price, p.writer_no AS writerNo, u.user_id AS memberId, u.nickname AS nickname, p.created_at AS createDate FROM PRODUCTS p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON p.writer_no = u.user_no WHERE p.product_id = #{boardId} AND p.is_deleted = 0
SELECT media_id AS imageId, product_id AS boardId, media_url AS imagePath, thumbnail_url AS saveName, media_type AS mediaType FROM PRODUCT_MEDIA WHERE product_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY media_order ASC

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.product_id AS boardId, c.content, c.created_at AS createDate, c.writer_no AS memberId, u.nickname AS nickname FROM COMMENTS c LEFT JOIN USERS u ON c.writer_no = u.user_no WHERE c.product_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.comment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENTS ( product_id, writer_no, content, created_at ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.delete: delete from wishlists where user_no = #{userNo} and product_id = #{productId}
